Bid Summary.value: The Dallas Independent School District is soliciting offers for student and staff computing devices, including laptops, desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. The purpose of this Request for Proposal is to procure vendors who provide goods or services purchased using federal, local, state, and grant-funded programs. Vendors may submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required, along with a variety of device accessories ordered in a bundle such as sleeves, cases, mice, keyboards, and cables. Each submission must include a detailed plan for tracking all shipped products and providing deployment services, alongside adherence to minimum hardware requirements and specifications over the multi-year contract term.

sources.file: JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices FINAL.pdf
sources.quote: This Request for Proposal (RFP) will be for student and staff computing devices, including laptops, desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors.

Bid Summary.notes: Successfully synthesized a 3 to 6 sentence bid summary outlining procurement scope, objectives, requirements, requested equipment, and deliverables based on the scope and specifications passages.

Product Specification.value: Student Devices Tier 1 Small Student Chromebook Laptop Minimum Requirements: Intel Celeron Processor N100 or equivalent, Display Minimum 11.6" diagonal, Integrated Camera 720p minimum, Screen Resolution 1366 x 768 Multi-touch, Memory Minimum 8GB DDR5 Memory, Wireless 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1, Power Supply Type C 65W, Battery Life Minimum 10 hours, Ports Minimum 2 USB 3.0; type C; 1 headphone/microphone combo, Storage 64 GB eMMC, Chrome O/S License Required, Warranty 1-year minimum. Tier 2 Large Student Chromebook Laptop Minimum Requirements: Intel Celeron Processor N100 or equivalent, Display Minimum 14" diagonal Non-Touch, Integrated Camera 720p minimum, Screen Resolution 1920-1080, Memory Minimum 8GB DDR5 Memory, Wireless 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1, Power Supply Type C 65W, Battery Life Minimum 10 Hours, Ports Minimum 2 USB 3.0; 1 Type C; 65HDMI; 1 headphone/microphone combo, Storage 128 GB eMMC, Chrome O/S License Required, Warranty 1-year minimum. Tier 3 Student Windows Laptop Minimum Requirements: Enterprise Management Ready w/ Autopilot Enrollment, Intel i5 13th Gen or equivalent, Display Minimum 13" diagonal, Integrated Camera 720p minimum. Student Tablet Minimum Requirements: Enterprise Management Ready, Processor A13, Display 10.2" Retina, Integrated Camera 8MP Wide camera, Screen Resolutions 2160 x 1620 Multi-touch, Wireless 802.11AC and Bluetooth 4.2, Power Supply included, Battery Life Minimum 10 Hours, Ports 1 headphone or other personal audio connection, Storage 64 GB, iOS 17, Warranty 1-year minimum. Staff Devices Tier 1 Staff Windows Basic Desktop Minimum Requirements: Enterprise Management Ready with Autopilot Enrollment, Processor Intel i5 Processor 14th Gen or equivalent, Display Minimum 23.8" diagonal screen Touch Screen, Memory Minimum 16GB RAM, Wireless 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1, Ports Minimum 3 USB 3.0; 2 USB-C1 HDMI; 1 headphone/microphone combo, Storage 512 GB NVMe SSD, Windows 11 Pro, Warranty 3-year minimum. Tier 2 Staff Professional Desktop Minimum Requirements: Enterprise Management Ready, Intel i7 Processor 14th Gen or equivalent, Display Minimum 23.8" diagonal screen Touch Screen, Memory Minimum 32GB DDR5 RAM, Wireless 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1, Ports Minimum 3 USB 3.0; 1 USB-C, 1 HDMI; 1 headphone/microphone combo, Storage 1 TB NVMe SSD, Windows 11 Pro or Mac O/S, 4 GB Video card, Touchscreen optional, Warranty 3-year minimum. Tier 1 Staff Basic Laptop Minimum Requirements: Enterprise Management Ready, Intel i5 CPU 14th Gen or equivalent, Display Minimum 13" diagonal screen, Integrated Camera 1080p, Memory Minimum 16GB DDR5 RAM, Wireless 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1, Power Supply USB Type C 65W, Battery Life Minimum 10 hours, Ports Minimum 1 USB 3.0;1 USB-C, 1 HDMI; 1 headphone/microphone combo, Storage 512 GB NVMe SSD, O/S Windows 11 or Mac OS, Warranty 3-year minimum. Tier 2 Staff Laptop Minimum Requirements: Enterprise Management Ready, Intel i7 CPU 14th Gen or equivalent, Display Minimum 13" diagonal screen, Integrated Camera 1080p, Resolution 1920 X 1080 minimum, Memory Minimum 32GB DDR5 RAM, Wireless 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1, Power Supply USB C 65W, Battery Life Minimum 10 hours, Ports Minimum 2 USB 3.0; 1 HDMI; 1 headphone/microphone combo, Storage 1 TB NVMe SSD, O/S Windows 11 or Mac OS, Warranty 3-year minimum. Display Monitor - Touch: Minimum 24" diagonal screen, Resolution 1920 X 1080, Port USB 3.1 Hub, Aspect Ratio 16:9, Contrast 3000:1, Warranty 3-year minimum. Display Monitor - Non-Touch: Minimum 24" diagonal screen, Resolution 1920 X 1080, Port USB 3.1 Hub, Warranty 3-year minimum.
